hero.title: 👑 Game of Thrones Name Generator
hero.tagline: Names from every corner of Westeros, with a house of your own or the right bastard surname.

article.intro: George R. R. Martin builds most Westerosi names from real medieval English ones with a letter changed: Eddard for Edward, Jaime for James, Petyr for Peter. Each region has its own flavour, Targaryens sound Valyrian, and bastards get a surname that tells you where they were born. This **Game of Thrones name generator** builds names for eight regions of Westeros, plus Valyrian and Free Folk names, as a noble with a new house, a bastard or a first name alone.

sections.heading: Bastard surnames by region
sections.content:
In Westeros, a highborn bastard can't use their father's name. They take a surname from the region they were born in, which is why Jon is a Snow and Ellaria is a Sand:

  • Snow: the North
  • Sand: Dorne
  • Rivers: the Riverlands
  • Stone: the Vale
  • Hill: the Westerlands
  • Flowers: the Reach
  • Storm: the Stormlands
  • Pyke: the Iron Islands
  • Waters: the Crownlands, around King's Landing

The generator's Bastard format gives each region its right surname. Valyrian names get Waters, as a Targaryen bastard born near King's Landing would.

sections.heading: How each region sounds
sections.content:
• The North: plain and old: Rickard, Benjen, Lyanna. Northern houses sound cold and hard.
  • The Westerlands: polished and proud, the Lannisters' country: Tywin, Kevan, Cersei.
  • The Reach: courtly and flowery, home of the Tyrells: Mace, Loras, Margaery.
  • Dorne: a different flavour altogether, after the Rhoynar who settled there: Oberyn, Doran, Arianne, Nymeria.
  • The Iron Islands: harsh and salty: Balon, Euron, Asha.
  • Valyrian: the Targaryens' names, full of ae and y: Aegon, Rhaegar, Daenerys, Viserys.
  • The Free Folk: one name, often with an epithet earned beyond the Wall: Tormund Giantsbane.

sections.heading: Making your character's name
sections.content:
• Take a real name and change a letter. It's Martin's own trick: Walter becomes Walder, Robert stays Robert, Edward becomes Eddard.
  • Choose a house with a sigil in mind. A house name like Frostmark or Saltspear suggests its own banner.
  • Decide if they're legitimate. A bastard's surname follows them everywhere, and changes the story.

All the first names and houses here are new, chosen so they don't belong to a major character. For their sword, try the Game of Thrones Sword Name Generator.

faqs.question: What are the bastard surnames in Game of Thrones?
faqs.answer: Each region has one: Snow (the North), Sand (Dorne), Rivers (Riverlands), Stone (Vale), Hill (Westerlands), Flowers (Reach), Storm (Stormlands), Pyke (Iron Islands) and Waters (Crownlands).

faqs.question: How does George R. R. Martin come up with names?
faqs.answer: Many are real medieval English names with a letter changed or a spelling twisted: Eddard (Edward), Jaime (James), Petyr (Peter), Walder (Walter).

faqs.question: Are these names from the books or the show?
faqs.answer: The bastard surnames are; the first names and houses are new, so your character won't belong to a family in the books.
